'''Saint-Venant''' ({{langx|vls|Papingem}}) is a [[Communes of France|commune]] in the [[Pas-de-Calais]] [[Departments of France|department]] (administrative division) in the Hauts-de-France [[region of France]]<ref>[https://www.insee.fr/fr/metadonnees/geographie/commune/62770-saint-venant INSEE commune file]</ref> about {{convert|9|mi|km|0}} northwest of [[Béthune]] and {{convert|26|mi|km|0}} west of [[Lille]], by the banks of the [[Lys (river)|Lys]].
